name: Ukraine
description: Follow Ukraine, a tracked place, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: Ukraine hits Russia's largest online marketplace, hurting small businesses and bringing the war home
changes.summary: The Ukrainian attacks on the sprawling Russian warehouses produced stark images, with massive pillars of black smoke rising above fires that raged at facilities of Wildberries, the country's biggest online retailer and its equivalent of Amazon.

changes.title: How volunteers with 3D printers make weapons for Ukraine
changes.summary: Last week, Ukrainian President Zelenskyy dismissed his tech-savvy defense minister. That sparked protests among supporters who credit him with helping transform Ukraine's defense capabilities. changes.title: Russia and Ukraine Trade Deadly Blows With Missiles and Drones
changes.summary: Ukrainian strikes set fire to warehouses and other sites in Russia, and Russian bombing rocked Ukraine’s capital, as the two countries escalated an air campaign.

changes.title: Laura Loomer meets with Ukraine's Zelenskyy after her major reversal on the war
changes.summary: Laura Loomer, an ardent ally of President Donald Trump with a reputation for incendiary social media commentary, sat down with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy on Thursday after a dramatic turnaround on the war that could have political reverberations back in Washington.

changes.title: Rubio says U.S. is ready to help end war in Ukraine but no quick deal ahead
changes.summary: Secretary of State Marco Rubio, who met with his Russian counterpart Sergey Lavrov, said that President Trump was committed to the work "if conditions and factors have changed to make that possible." (Image credit: BRENDAN SMIALOWSKI).

changes.title: Zelensky’s Dizzying U-Turn Is the Latest Zigzag in a Presidency Full of Them
changes.summary: President Volodymyr Zelensky of Ukraine has pivoted from unpopular moves before, but a recent decision about military leadership and strategy could weaken his position.

changes.title: A New Target for Ukraine’s Long-Range Attacks: Russia’s Version of Amazon
changes.summary: Kyiv is escalating its air war by striking commercial warehouses, trying to bring the conflict closer to home for ordinary Russians.

changes.title: Ukraine targets Russian online retailer Wildberries
changes.summary: Ukrainian long-range drones targeted large warehouses belonging to Wildberries, Russia’s equivalent of Amazon, which sells military equipment like body armor and drone parts, but mainly serves as a place for regular Russians to sell their goods. President Zelenskyy said the warehouses are “involved in supplying the Rus.

changes.title: Firing of Ukraine’s Top General Signals the End of an Era
changes.summary: Gen. Oleksandr Syrskyi, who commanded crucial battles, oversaw an expansion of drone warfare against Russia, but many Ukrainians want even more.

changes.title: Ukraine's Zelenskyy fires top military commander amid ongoing protests
changes.summary: Ukraine's President Volodymyr Zelenskyy fires the country's army chief, just days after he dismissed the defense minister. Those two key figures had been feuding with each other.
